narrative.title: The Dominant Tenant in the Access Records
narrative.scenario: A facilities dashboard aggregates swipe records from one building and knows that a single employee account generated more than half of them. Reporting the busiest account by tallying every swipe would need a records-sized table. Identify the dominant account in one pass with constant extra memory.
narrative.inputFormat: An array nums of n integers, one account id per swipe.
narrative.outputFormat: The value that occurs more than floor(n / 2) times.
constraints: A majority element is guaranteed to exist

testCases.explanation: Account 3 accounts for two of the three swipes, which exceeds half.
Account 2 swipes four times out of seven, holding the majority despite the interleaving.

hintLevels: Level 1: A value more frequent than everything else combined cannot be fully cancelled out by the rest.
Level 2: Carry one candidate plus a support counter: matching swipes raise it, differing swipes lower it, and when the counter hits zero the next account becomes the new candidate.
Level 3: The counter must be reset correctly before comparing the incoming value, and the final candidate must be held until the last record rather than overwritten when support runs out mid-scan.
